details:
So, been playing on Quest 2 from a month now, And randomly, I do have a weird bug that can have multiple form :

I can't hear a certain person in the instance even if they talk to me and I do see there nickname lighting up, telling me that they are trying to talk to me. (They are not muted)

I can't hear a certain person in the instance, and from time to time, it loop from an old sentence (Exemple : The person say : "Hello I love Pizza !", Whenever they will try to talk again after it will just repeat again and again the same sentence)

Or sometimes It's a mix of the two that randomly fix itself with sometimes just coming back again.

It seem to happen when I do have an internet crash most of the times, but sometimes it's just here, Did only happen in instance with lot of people too. At least, it were I did notice it.

The only problem with this bug is that, when it's happen, there isn't any "client side way" to fix it, did had it one time and did try to relaunch the game, change totally version of the game and play on the beta, rejoin multiple time, relaunch the quest, still having the issues on a special person

I did find a kind of fix that make the concerned person obligated to rejoin, but, not sure if it's work for all the case since only did test it one time and too, it's was just the fact that I wasn't able to hear them (not the repeating sentence case)
title: [Quest] One Player Voice specifically in instance looping or not working.
